g.title: Deny / error / cancel Abort CAS wins
Reject / timeout / cancel Abort CAS wins
S4 cannot qualify Abort CAS wins
Fresh scoped recovery Inspect / admit evidence / settle
No result branch returns to dispatch. Emitter closure and accounting remain independent records. Missing durable replies are unresolved commands; ResultRecorded does not mean global completion.
